title: The Conductor
tagline: A batch of issues, one question at a time
intro: The Conductor runs a batch of issues for you, each piece of work in its own isolated copy of the repository.

steps.say: You hand it a batch of issues, and it asks you each question one at a time, with the option it recommends first.
do: python3 conductor.py ask demo --kind spend --question "Spend up to 40 dollars on this batch?" --option approve --option decline --recommended approve --why "four small issues"

steps.say: It refuses an answer that is not one of the options, and it refuses any answer written by one of its own workers.
do: python3 conductor.py answer demo ask-1 maybe
CONDUCTOR_WORKER=1 python3 conductor.py answer demo ask-1 approve

steps.say: Only your own pick is written down, and only once.
do: python3 conductor.py answer demo ask-1 approve
python3 conductor.py answer demo ask-1 approve

outro: Nothing spends money or merges until you have said yes.
